requirement_statement: synthetic_actor_id must conform to SYN-ROLE-NNN format; non-conforming IDs must be rejected at construction
SyntheticActor must not allow authentication_state to be set to AUTHENTICATED; must raise SyntheticIdentityError
is_synthetic must always be True on all synthetic actors; must not be overrideable
identity_assurance must always be SIMULATED_ONLY; no production assurance may be claimed
No PII (email / phone / long numeric ID) permitted in any SyntheticActor field; must be rejected at construction
Valid synthetic actor with compliant ID and display_label must be accepted without error
SyntheticActor must not have missing_prefix format ID; SYN- prefix is mandatory
Default registry actors must all have valid SYN-ROLE-NNN IDs and NOT_AUTHENTICATED state
PI role must be permitted to CREATE_DRAFT_PROJECT
PI role must be permitted to EDIT_DRAFT_ARTIFACT
PI role must be permitted to RECORD_REVIEW_ATTESTATION with review_type=SELF_REVIEW
DATA_MANAGER must be permitted to UNLOCK_RESEARCH_DATA when has_controlled_change_authorization=True
EVIDENCE_CITATION_REVIEWER must be permitted to RECORD_EVIDENCE_ATTESTATION for external source (is_own_source=False)
FINAL_APPROVAL must be blocked for all roles without exception
ETHICS_APPROVAL must be blocked for all roles without exception
INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_APPROVAL must be blocked for all roles without exception
EXTERNAL_SUBMISSION must be in FORBIDDEN_ACTIONS_ALL_ROLES; blocked pre-RBAC check
CLINICAL_RELEASE must be in FORBIDDEN_ACTIONS_ALL_ROLES; blocked pre-RBAC check
PI must be blocked from recording INDEPENDENT_REVIEW of own artifact (SoD-01)
SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR must be blocked from research-content approval actions (SoD-02)
READ_ONLY_AUDITOR must be blocked from all write actions (SoD-03)
DATA_MANAGER must be blocked from UNLOCK_RESEARCH_DATA without controlled-change authorization (SoD-04)
DATA_MANAGER must be allowed to UNLOCK_RESEARCH_DATA with controlled-change authorization (SoD-04 positive case)
EVIDENCE_CITATION_REVIEWER must be blocked from self-attesting own source (SoD-05)
DISABLED actor must be blocked from any action regardless of role or action type (SoD-08)
Actor with all role assignments expired must be blocked from performing protected action (SoD-07)
BLOCK decision must contain all required structured fields: decision / reason_code / policy_reference / actor_reference / action / object_reference / timestamp_utc
Self-delegation (principal_id == delegatee_id) must raise DelegationError
Delegation with any forbidden action in permitted_actions must raise DelegationError
Delegation lifecycle must progress PROPOSED → ACTIVE → REVOKED correctly with correct status at each state
Delegation that passes effective_until_utc must return EXPIRED status (auto-expiry without explicit call)
REJECTED delegation must not be activatable; activate() must raise DelegationError if status is REJECTED
Audit event must contain all 17 required fields as specified in R1.0 schema
is_synthetic must be True on all audit events; must not be overrideable to False
production_valid must be False on all audit events; must not be overrideable to True
authentication_context must always be SIMULATED_NOT_AUTHENTICATED on all audit events
audit_event_hash must be present non-empty 64-character SHA-256 hex string on every event
AuditAttributionLedger must not expose DELETE / UPDATE / REMOVE / TRUNCATE / CLEAR methods
Events must accumulate in ledger across multiple record() calls without overwriting
verify() must return PASS for an unmodified valid ledger with correct hash chain
verify() must return FAIL and report errors when any event in the ledger has been tampered with
disclaimer "Not valid for production authorization" must appear in BLOCK decision output
4 new CLI commands must be registered and callable: rbac-simulate / delegation-register / delegation-status / audit-attribution-verify
